create.name: Philip Shepherd
create.bio:
Philip Shepherd is a writer and teacher of embodiment. He developed The Embodied Present Process, a set of practices meant to bring the thinking of the head back into partnership with the quieter intelligence of the body. His route there was long and varied: a teenage bicycle journey alone across Europe, the Middle East, India and Japan, study of classical Noh theatre in Japan, years of bodywork, and a career as a stage actor in London, New York, Chicago and Toronto. Out of this came two books, New Self, New World, ten years in the writing, and Radical Wholeness, which argue that our culture trains us to live in our heads and lose touch with the present.

His approach turns the usual idea of 'listening to the body' around: rather than observing the body from the head, students learn to sense the world through the body and to rest in it. He teaches through online courses, guided practices, one-to-one coaching over Zoom, workshops in many countries and a year-long training for facilitators, which he co-directs with Allyson Woodrooffe. He also speaks at conferences and festivals on embodiment, and shares talks and guided practices freely on his YouTube channel.

books.title: Radical Wholeness: The Embodied Present and the Ordinary Grace of Being
books.author: Philip Shepherd
books.description: His second book sets out the case that modern culture has split thinking from the body and the present, and offers practices for returning to a whole, grounded way of being. Published by North Atlantic Books in 2017.

books.title: New Self, New World
books.author: Philip Shepherd
books.description: His first book, on how Western culture came to live in the head, and on recovering the senses and the body's own intelligence. Published by North Atlantic Books in 2010.

courses.title: Embodiment Coaching
courses.description: One-to-one sessions over Zoom with practices and perspectives from The Embodied Present Process, tailored to where you are.

courses.title: Embodiment Facilitator Training
courses.description: A year-long training, co-led with Allyson Woodrooffe, for people who want to guide others in The Embodied Present Process.

courses.title: Essential 8 Embodied Meditations
courses.description: Eight core guided practices meant to build embodiment into daily life, as a foundation for the rest of his work.
